chapters.main:
Title: The Obsidian Crown

The kingdom of Elara was unfolding under a dark shadow. Malakor, known as the King of the Iron Citadel, stood atop the balcony, his armor clinking in the cold wind. He whispered a low, gravelly rasp to himself, clutching his obsidian sword.

Nearby, Queen Elara watched him with a sharp, poetic gaze. She was the Ruler of the Sun-Drenched Valleys, and she didn't trust Malakor; he was once her father’s most loyal general, but now he was merely a shadow of the man he used to be.

Tense and alert, Kaelen, a Young Royal Guard, gripped his spear tightly. Kaelen was Malakor’s secret nephew, a fact that could get them both executed if Elara ever found out. The secret was a heavy burden, pressing down on him as he stood watch over the stone halls.
